summary: Explains requiring variables with the mandatory filter when DEFAULT_UNDEFINED_VAR_BEHAVIOR is false, and forcing users to override a variable with undef(hint=...).
questions: How do I require a variable to be set if undefined vars are allowed?
How do I force users to override a variable with a helpful message?
What does the undef() function do?

answer_card.title: Mandatory values and undef()
answer_card.answer_md:
Ansible fails on undefined variables by default. If you set `DEFAULT_UNDEFINED_VAR_BEHAVIOR` to `false`, require specific ones with:

```jinja
{{ variable | mandatory }}
```

To force an override with a hint:

```yaml
galaxy_api_key: "{{ undef(hint='You must specify your Galaxy API key') }}"
```
